name: Legato
driverConfig: Dual dynamic: 12mm woofer + 6mm tweeter (DLC composite diaphragms)
cons: Midrange can take a back seat to the bass
Not ideal for those seeking neutral or reference tuning
insight: Legato is unapologetically a bass-focused dual dynamic driver IEM. The 12mm woofer delivers a large, physical sub-bass shelf that many reviewers described as jaw-rattling, while the smaller 6mm driver handles mids and treble. It is one of the more successful ‘fun’ tunings from 7Hz and works especially well for electronic, hip-hop, and any genre that benefits from strong low-end authority.
